name: SINTEGRA (national portal of the state taxpayer registries)
tier_rationale: Government portal of the state tax administrations (A8 trusted); P250 cond 5: 'trusted - Portal da Transparencia (CGU), Receita Federal, Sintegra/CCC, consumidor.gov.br, REDESIM/juntas comerciais, Jusbrasil, Reclame Aqui; community - Escavador, Casa dos Dados'.

reliability.justification: Official state registration (inscricao estadual) records, per state.

portal_page.title: SINTEGRA national portal (static manual link: the analyst picks the state and types the CNPJ)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

portal_page.notes: Quote: binding council text (P250 cond 1). The national portal is a frameset that links to each state's lookup and takes no CNPJ parameter (verified 2026-11-26); the CCC/SVRS lookup now redirects to a login and is excluded (P311 login lint). Used by pivots_brazil.

notes: Manual pivot links only (batch p2-G14-2): V3LUM never fetches them (P311).
